clips.title: The story
paras: North Gate Pass carries travelers between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan through the Khaz Modan peaks. A fortified dwarven outpost watches this northern corridor, used by travelers bound for the Wetlands.

North Gate Pass cuts through Khaz Modan between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. From the west, travelers emerge from steep mountain tunnels into the broad loch valley. Roads lead down toward the Wetlands, bringing dwarven messengers, merchants, and wandering adventurers through the pass. North Gate Outpost gives the route its strategic value, with mountaineers watching for troggs and mountain predators.
